message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts. Facts: drunk driving with blood alcohol 136.55 mg/100ml (i.e., 0.1365% BAC). In China, drunk driving (driving under influence) is a criminal offense: "危险驾驶罪" (dangerous driving) under Article 133 of Criminal Law, specifically "醉酒驾驶机动车" is "危险驾驶罪". Also, the person is a repeat offender: previously convicted of "过失损坏军事通信罪" and was under probation. Reoffending during probation period leads to "重新判处原判决的刑罚" or "在考验期内再犯新罪" may lead to "考验期内再犯新罪" which can be considered as "重新判处原判决的刑罚" plus "加重处罚". But the new crime is drunk driving. Also, because he was under probation, the new crime may be considered as "在考验期内再犯新罪" which under Chinese law leads to "在考验期内再犯新罪的，原判处的刑罚不予执行，重新判处新罪" (the original sentence is not executed). However the crime itself remains "危险驾驶罪". Also possibly "交通肇事罪"? No, because no accident. So just dangerous driving.

Thus answer: [罪名]危险驾驶罪<eoa>
